files_or_snippet: formulakit@0.1.0 dist/index.js: src/lexer.ts tokenize(), src/parser.ts Parser (Pratt parser, BP table, right-assoc ^ via bp-1, unary operand at BP 65); package.json repository https://github.com/trananhtung/formulakit
how_adapted: Retained the Pratt parser structure and binding-power scheme (^ right-assoc above unary above */% above +-). Removed comparison, logical, ternary, identifier, function-call and builtin support; replaced the number lexer with the spec's integer/decimal/exponent grammar; made all errors CalcError with 0-based positions; added explicit errors for missing operands, unbalanced parentheses, division/remainder by zero and non-finite results; added the evaluator over a small AST.
